questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: Why school rules make children behave better
A school in Thailand where the pupils run almost everything
How bamboo is used to build cheap houses and schools in Thailand
The problems of private schools in Asia
questions.why: They talk about the Bamboo School, “a school run by students, for students”.

questions.q: What did Georgie not like about her own school days?
options: The teachers
The school food
The homework
The rules
questions.why: She enjoyed school most of the time, but didn't like “the school rules!”

questions.q: Which of these jobs do the Bamboo School children do?
options: Hiring new staff
Building new classrooms
Teaching all the lessons
Selling vegetables at the market
questions.why: Phil says the children do everything from buying food to disciplining students and hiring new staff.

questions.q: How often do children go to the market to buy food?
options: Every day
Once a month
Twice a week
Only at weekends
questions.why: Georgie says twice a week they go with a school officer and buy food for all 150 students.

questions.q: Why does Nooneem enjoy managing the food accounts?
options: Because she gets paid for it
Because she likes accounting and it's a real job
Because it means she can miss lessons
Because her teachers help her with it all the time
questions.why: She was already interested in accounting and enjoys doing “the actual job”.

questions.q: How was Nooneem's old school different?
options: It had far more rules about food
It was also run by the pupils
It only had lessons, then pupils went home
It was more expensive, but it was also more fun
questions.why: She says her old school was “just classes and then home”.

questions.q: What does reporter William Kramer say about the school?
options: It has no adults at all
It is exactly like other schools
The children are in charge of the classrooms as well
It is traditional in some ways and very new in others
questions.why: He says it's quite conventional in some ways and really innovative, even radical, in others.

questions.q: How much community service do the children do?
options: Two hours every week
Two hours every day
One day every month
Only during the holidays
questions.why: Phil says children do two hours of community service every week.
